A provider's asynchronous result for a connector step. The engine verifies the HMAC the adapter declares over the raw body first, maps the payload to the onboarding it belongs to and to step data, and then submits that data exactly as the flow's submit route would, so the same workflow outcomes and the same refusals apply. A replay of a callback already applied is acknowledged and ignored.
